description_en: The Gaṇeśa Temple, located in the Ikhālakhu Ṭola of Patan, is a south-facingśikhara-style temple and is built in stone. Three steps lead upwards to the sanctum. On the southern plinth, statues of two sitting lions guard the main entrance, one on either side. On the western plinth are five rows of stepped oil-lamps. Two octagonal stone columns support a portico and on the lintel at the top of the columns are two images of an endless knot. On the stone beam which is supported by the two columns stands a small statue of a standing Gaṇeśa. The eastern, northern and western facades are decorated with niches topped by akīrtimukhatoraṇa. The eastern side of the temple is open while other two are closed. Placed in the western niche are two stone inscriptions.A portico supported by two columns extends from the southern façade of the temple. A stone pinnacle sits on top of a bell-shaped structure at the top of this porch, which itself is about half as tall as the temple. On the top of the portico is a niche with a stone statue of Gaṇeśa. The stonetoraṇaabove the image has broken into pieces. On two sides, the pieces have been fixed together again, however the piece which should fit in the upper middle part is missing. The remaining parts of thetoraṇashow that there was akīrtimukhatoraṇa. In the niche, the four-armed Gaṇeśa is idepicted in a seated position. On the four corners of the temple, slightly below the level of the Gaṇeśa statue are images ofśārdūlassitting on lotus pedestals. Built into the the four sides of the temple are four small niches with a female deity and akīrtimukhatoraṇa.In the four corners above, an image of fourśārdūlasarejvalānhāyakãsplaced on lotus pedestals. A bronze pinnacle sits at the very top of the temple.Inside the temple, there is a stone statue of Gaṇeśa on a stone pedestal. Above the pedestal is another pedestal in the shape of lotus flower, upon which there are images of two small rats on which Gaṇeśa is standing. Images of various deities are depicted on thetoraṇa: The top central image on thetoraṇais that of Bhairava flanked by two attendants; below are the images ofaṣṭamātṛkās, four on each side, and at the bottom lie two images on either side in the positions forālīḍhaandpratyālīḍha. There is a parasol on top of thetoraṇa.Gutschow writes that, "The tower rises from a profiled platform, from which pedestals of the guarding lions project. The pair of octagonal towers bear capitals with medallions enclosing the endless knot (nadyavārta) and Gaṇeśa on the lintel. A corbelled vault of 12 steps highlights the sanctum, occupied by Gaṇeśa. The projecting pavilion has a latticed apron panel, sheltering one more representations of Gaṇeśa. The tower is guarded by a variety if elements: blind windows featuring a bust of Śiva (?) emerge from the central panels. Mythic animals (śārdūla), appear in the corners on a lotus base, at half height four discuses are seen as emblems of power and protection, which are repeated above the roof cornice in axial position. The vase of plenty (kalaśa) with the emerging gem on an amalaka ring is in turn supported by a bell-shaped base with amalaka ring” (Gutschow2011 vol. II: 552)The inscription attached to the temple informs that the temple was constructed in 1726 by Balabhadra Bhāro. It collapsed during the earthquake of 1934 and was renovated in 1942.
description_ne: गणेश मन्दिर पाटनको इखालखु टोलमा रहेको छ । शिखर शैलीमा बनेको दक्षिणतर्फ फर्केको यो मन्दिर ढुङ्गाले बनेको छ । मन्दिरको गर्भगृहभित्र जानको लागि तीन वटा खुड्किला चड्नु पर्छ । मन्दिरको दक्षिणतर्फको पेटीमा मूल द्वारको अगाडि दायाँबायाँ दुवै तर्फ बसेका सिंहका प्रतिमा छन् । मन्दिरको पश्चिमी पेटीमा पाँच तह भएको दीपमालिका राखिएको छ । मूलद्वारको अगाडि ढुङ्गाका दुई वटा आठकोणे स्तम्भ छन् जसले माथिको बुर्जालाई थामेका छन् । स्तम्भ भन्दा माथि ढुङ्गामा नद्यावर्तका प्रतिमा कुँदिएका छन् । ती दुई स्तम्भमाथि रहेको बीमको बीचमा उभिएका गणेशको प्रतिमा कुँदिएको छ । मन्दिरको पूर्वी, उत्तरी र दक्षिणी मोहडामा कीर्तिमुख तोरण सहितका खोपी रहेका छन् ।  तीमध्ये पूर्वतर्फ रहेको कीर्तिमुख तोरण मुनिको भाग खुला छ र त्यहाँ प्लहामका पाताले बनेको ढोका हालिएको छ । पश्चिमपट्टि रहेको तोरणमुनि दुई वटा ढुङ्गाका अभिलेख टाँसिएका छन् ।मन्दिरको दक्षिणी मोहडामा एउटा बुर्जा छ जुन दुई वटा स्तम्भद्वारा थामिएका छन् । बुर्जाको शिरमा घण्टाकार संरचनामाथि गजुर राखिएको छ, जुन भाग पूरै मन्दिरको उचाएको लगभग आधा जस्तो देखिन्छ । बुर्जाभित्र गणेशको ढुङ्गाको मूर्ति राखिएको छ । त्यसमाथि राखिएको ढुङ्गाको तोरण टुक्रिएर बीचको भाग हराएको छ । छेउछाउका बाँकी भागका आधारमा त्यो तोरण कीर्तिमुख तोरण हो भनी अन्दाज गर्न सकिन्छ । त्यहाँ रहेका गणेश बसेको मुद्रामा छन् र उनका चार हात छन् । गणेशको प्रतिमा भन्दा अलि तल मन्दिरको चार कुनामा कमल फूलको पीठिकामा बसेका शार्दूलको प्रतिमा छन् । मन्दिरका चारै मोहडामा कीर्तिमुख तोरण भएका चार वटा खोपी छन् र हरेकमा कुनै देवीको शिरको प्रतिमा छ ।  शार्दूलको प्रतिमाभन्दा माथि चारै कुनामा कमल फूलको पीठिकामा ज्वालन्हायकम् राखिएका छन् । मन्दिरको टुप्पामा पित्तलको गजुर राखिएको छ ।मन्दिरभित्र ढुङ्गाको पीठिकामाथि गणेशको धुङ्गाकै मूर्ति छ । तल्लो पीठिकामाथि अर्को कमलको फूल कुँदिएको पीठिका छ जसमाथि दुईवटा साना मुसाका प्रतिमा छन् जसमा टेकेर चार हात भएका गणेश उभिएका छन् । गणेशको माथि भएको तोरणमा विभिन्न देवताहरूको प्रतिमा कुँदिएको छ । सबैभन्दा माथि बीचमा भैरवको प्रतिमा कुँदिएको छ र उनका दुई छेउमा उनका सहचरहरू रहेका छन् । गणेशको दायाँ र बयाँ, एकातर्फ चार वटा रहने गरी अष्टमातृकाका प्रतिमाहरू कुँदिएका छन् । तोरणको फेदमा आलीढ र प्रत्यालीढ मुद्रामा दुई मूर्ति रहेका छन् । तोरणको शिरमा छत्र रहेको छ ।मन्दिरको भित्तामा रहेको अभिलेखमा दि इएको जानकारी अनुसार यो मन्दिर सन् १७२६ मा बलभद्र भारोद्वारा बनाइएको हो । सन् १९३४ को भूकम्पमा परी मन्दिर ध्वस्त भएको थियो र सन् १९४२ मा यसको पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो ।

historical_events.event_description: The stone temple was constructed, alakṣyāhutiyajñawas performed and aguṭhīwas endowed by Balabhadra Bhāro, son of Manohara Siṃha Bhāro.
The temple was renovated after the 1934 earthquake by Nandakumarī and her sons Maṅgalakṛṣṇa and Mohanakṛṣṇa.
